title: Starcrafting: The Starforge
description: A crafting window where players infuse unenchanted starsteel items with their prepared spells. Drag an item into the forge, choose a runic etching, and cast spells into it from your spellbook, spending real spell slots. A crafting log tracks every item's progress, with 15 casts needed per spell level. Higher slots add progress, a school etching doubles casts of its school, and Mastercrafted items hold two spells.
